# vigil — MCP Config

Configuring a client means pasting a snippet into its settings file.

## Client Snippet

The block below is a sample, not a section of this note:

```markdown
## Fenced Example

A [[fenced-target]] reference nobody should resolve.
```

Everything past the closing delimiter is prose again.

## Troubleshooting

Restart the client after editing the snippet.
